name: Hof Walch
beschreibung: The Hof Walch welcomes guests to the idyllic hamlet of Schönau in Bach im Lechtal, situated in the heart of the Tiroler Lech Nature Park. This traditional family farmhouse offers comfortable guest rooms furnished with native timber, featuring en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing magnificent views of the Lechtal and Allgäu Alps. Each morning, a nutritious breakfast buffet loaded with farm produce and local delicacies is served. The setting is ideal for outdoor enthusiasts: in summer, the renowned Lechweg long-distance trail passes through the valley, while hikes up the Jöchelspitze await. In winter, ski buses connect effortlessly to the Jöchelspitze lifts and into Ski Arlberg via Warth-Schröcken.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional farm guesthouse in Schönau near Bach in the Lechtal featuring cosy rooms and close to the Lechweg.
